# Vendored browser dependencies

These pinned files let the main app run without network access.

- Three.js r128, including OrbitControls: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r128 (MIT; THREE-LICENSE.txt).
- Simplex Noise 2.4.0: https://github.com/jwagner/simplex-noise.js/tree/2.4.0 (MIT; SIMPLEX-LICENSE.txt).

The historical HTML examples retain their original CDN dependencies. Runtime libraries are not upgraded implicitly; rendering changes need browser verification.
